description: Update the rich detail on the authenticated user's most-recent open ownership record for a game (purchase price, source, trade detail, trim, sale price). The user must currently own the game. Pass any subset of fields; omitted fields are left untouched. Acts on the API key owner's own library. Available on every tier, but agents that make many calls per task burn through a free-tier daily quota quickly. Email colin@kineticist.com for a higher ceiling.

gameId.description: Game UUID. Accepts both the raw UUID and the 'gm_'-prefixed form that get_game_details returns (prefix stripped automatically).

salePrice.description: USD. Only meaningful for previously-owned (closed) records.

name: kineticist_update_ownership_details
title: Edit ownership details
